purpose: Read-only candidate archive metadata, not an installed environment or lockfile
method: uv dry-run; version-specific PyPI JSON; bounded ZIP directory HTTP Range reads; one 23635-byte py37-none-any wheel read in full
candidate_selection: Smallest compressed compatible Linux manylinux/x86_64 or universal Python3.12 candidate found, not necessarily the wheel a final installer will choose
limitations: Archive sums do not deduplicate cross-package path collisions
No pyc/JIT/runtime data or peak temporary install space included
Expected SHA256 is from PyPI metadata; full large-wheel contents were not downloaded or hashed
No environment installation, GPU run, model download or model API call

correction.reason: Initial platform filter incorrectly admitted macOS x86_64; corrected to Linux x86_64 or universal candidates. All 198 final candidate tags checked; no invalid platform remains.
